intent: Primary interactive control that triggers an action in place.
use_when: An action taken in place: Save, Apply, Delete.
The one primary action in a view (use style Primary).
dont_use_when: Navigation to another view — use a link.

a11y.focus: focus-visible ring bound to the focus-ring token; disabled is removed from the tab order.
a11y.contrast: label vs background >= 4.5:1 in light and dark.
